news.h: Miami Dolphins backup QB Kyle McCord showed poise in debut vs. Indianapolis Colts
news.d: Miami coach Jeff Hafley praised McCord's poise and the trust he showed in receivers Malik Washington and Caleb Douglas.

news.h: QB Kyle McCord eager to make his 1st NFL start as Dolphins and Colts meet in battle of reeling teams
news.d: — Miami Dolphins quarterback Kyle McCord has dreamed about this moment his entire life.
